about: A third round of the tests Trillion-X/trillion PR #243 (4ffa1dc4a2) deleted with no home and no port-backlog row (its backlog listed only source and data), carried byte for byte from 1e886c3f68 (the parent of 7fd8838475, which moved 1,028 of the files they import into this repository; each test there has the same bytes as at the tag old-trillion-before-worker-retire, and its imports still name a file) into the Workshop tool that now holds the code each one tests. Each group is one tool and the tests whose subject it holds; every file they import is already home in this repository (an earlier lane moved it), so only the tests and their test help move. the first two rounds are trillion-pr243-tests-to-workshop.json and -2.json; these are screen tests whose screen code is home here and in trillion-apps web/, carried here because only here is every file they reach (the headless browser among them) home; docs/pr243-deleted-tests.json lists every such test and where it went. Test help a test reads by its address (a fixture page) is named as an owner of its group, since the import closure does not follow a path read.

calls.means: This repository is public and holds made-up data only: a real person's first name used as a test's sample owner becomes a made-up one. Nothing else in the file changes.
This repository is public and holds made-up data only: a real person's first name in a test's note about whose store a measure came from becomes a made-up one. Nothing else in the file changes.
